name: Kaneishi Nanami
source:
A charming girl, with a cute smile. 

She’s friendly and forthcoming, a genuine girl with an open-minded attitude, and has a lot of male friends. 

She currently has a boyfriend the same age as her, and she tends to act all cute and childish only in front of him.
